source_documents.role: The shipped providers construct the timeout prefix, bounded partial output, and shell-reset diagnostic consumed by the model.
Focused stub tests assert the complete timeout and reset wording for both shell dialects.
Paired package READMEs and the durable rationale note state the shipped timeout result wording.
The owned keyless snapshot families exercise the Bash SDK and PowerShell headless model-visible entry paths.

findings.summary: Both focused provider tests now assert the complete timeout prefix and the complete fresh-shell reset message, while the paired READMEs and durable rationale describe the same result wording.
findings.limitations: The focused tests use deterministic terminal stubs; they do not replace a supported native PowerShell execution lane.

findings.summary: The official snapshot harness replays the persistent Bash SDK scenario successfully. The PowerShell headless scenario is discovered but skipped by its manifest because this Linux host has no supported PowerShell executable; the package-level PowerShell timeout test still executes against the deterministic provider stub.
findings.limitations: The Windows/PowerShell snapshot lane remains CI-owned and was not executed on this host.

changes: Synchronized Bash and PowerShell README timeout and reset wording with the shipped provider strings.
Synchronized the durable minimal-profile Agent Note and its Chinese pairing.
Strengthened both focused timeout tests to assert the complete model-visible prefix and reset sentence.
Kept the existing owned Bash SDK and PowerShell headless keyless snapshot families and replayed them through the official harness.
unchanged: No Session format or released Session JSONL generation changed.
No snapshot fixture was regenerated without a model key.
No PowerShell-only source execution was claimed on the Linux host.

decision.result: AAA-011:A02 PASS — diagnostics, documentation, focused tests, and owned keyless snapshot entry paths agree
decision.diagnosis: The stale generic timeout documentation and weak substring assertions are corrected. The shipped providers already emitted the detailed wording; the implementation now records and verifies that wording consistently across Bash and PowerShell surfaces.
decision.next_action: Complete AAA-011 and advance to the next independent task; retain the Windows PowerShell snapshot lane as a CI-owned platform check.

pnpm exec tsc -p packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/shell/tool-pwsh-persistent/tsconfig.json --noEmit

node scripts/verify-customization-policy.mjs --base master && pnpm run verify-translation-pairing packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/README.md packages/shell/tool-pwsh-persistent/README.md .agents/notes/implemented/simplification/2026-09-03-minimal-profiles-persistent-shell-only.md && git diff --check
